The policy excerpts: DOC-043 says default reports group by status, but Reports → Custom → New report lets any report be built around a different grouping, including tag, assignee or a custom field. Also selecting “Tag” as group-by dimension on a new custom report produces rows per tag. So grouping by tag is not a built-in report option; you need a custom report. So answer: need custom report. Provide short answer. Use post_reply.
